_note: Optional example questions. Only the question is prepared; Agent 1 writes every answer live, so results differ between runs. Employees can type any question instead. 'why' says what each one tests.

questions.label: $80,000 cash withdrawal
questions.question: A customer wants to withdraw $80,000 in cash at the branch today. Who needs to approve it?
questions.why: v3.0 §3.3: Branch Manager AND Branch Operations Head, plus 1 business day notice. The repository still holds v2.1 (Branch Manager only, same day).

questions.label: $25,000 cash withdrawal
questions.question: Does a $25,000 over-the-counter cash withdrawal need approval?
questions.why: v3.0 §3.2: Branch Manager approval above $20,000. Under superseded v2.1 the teller alone could process up to $30,000.

questions.label: Foreign national account
questions.question: What documents does a foreign national on an Employment Pass need to open a savings account at the branch?
questions.why: SOP_OPS_034 §3.1-3.3: passport, pass with 6 months validity, proof of address within 3 months. Three required items, easy to leave one out.

questions.label: Fee waiver of $300
questions.question: Can a Customer Service Officer waive a $300 fee for a customer?
questions.why: SOP_OPS_047: CSO up to $50 only; $50-$500 needs the Branch Manager.

questions.label: Daily travel allowance
questions.question: How much can I claim per day for an overseas business trip, and does my claim need approval?
questions.why: Travel v1 and v2 disagree ($120 + auto-approval vs $150 + manager approval).

questions.label: Rule on a past date
questions.question: What was the hotel limit for overseas business trips in 2025?
questions.why: Policy validation: the question names 2025, so the superseded v1.0 ($200/night) is the version in effect then.

questions.label: Not covered by policy
questions.question: How much paid maternity leave do employees get?
questions.why: No document covers this. Expect the assistant to decline, or TrustGuard to return Insufficient evidence.
